title: IPC acute food insecurity in Lebanon, by analysis, period and area
publisher: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC), FAO, WFP and partners, via OCHA HDX
license: CC0 (public domain), as stated on HDX

phases.3+: Phase 3 or worse (Crisis, Emergency or Catastrophe)

fields: phase: {phase: [people, share]}. Shares are published rounded, to two decimals. people are IPC estimates, not counts.
notes: An 'area' is an IPC analysis unit as named by the source: a district crossed with a population group in the Mar 2026 and Oct 2025 analyses ('Aley - Leb' Lebanese residents, 'Aley - Syr' Syrian refugees), a district or 'district Refugees' in the earlier ones. 'groups' are the Level 1 totals (districts in 2022 to 2024, population groups in Oct 2025); 'national' is the country total, 'group' null. Areas carry no OCHA pcode in the source. 'country_population_total' repeats the source column (0 in the Oct 2025 analysis, as published). Six Nov 2024 rows (Marjaayoun, Bent Jbeil and Sour 'Refugees') carry a population of 0 and no phase split, as published. The Mar 2026 analysis has a first projection (Apr to Aug 2026) and no 'current' period in the file.
